limitations: The desktop enables optional AcousticBrainz enrichment, but musiccheck omitted AcousticBrainzURL in these historical runs. They did not exercise its lookup or scoring contribution. The current runner enables it with -online, but these results are not measurements of the later v17 source-priority policy.
40/40 is a result for these cases and installed assets, not a guarantee for every prompt, seed, provider state or catalog.
27 outcomes remain partial because CLAP similarity is uncalibrated and only preview segments were assessed; 13 reference-only outcomes are fulfilled.
No held-out human listening assessment, calibrated genre accuracy, exact tempo or measured perceptual-energy trajectory was established.

Per-case timings exclude process/model startup and worker health checks. Cache warmth and background validation work varied; do not interpret the runs as a controlled before/after performance benchmark.
Strict instrumental screening reached its analysis budget and retained ten checked tracks; this case took 776113 ms.

Unavailable assets/previews, ambiguous identities and contradictory hard requirements can still prevent fulfillment. No constraints were silently removed or unrelated tracks used merely to pad counts.
Only derived embeddings/features and metadata caches were retained; no preview audio was saved.
